# Cargo Technician
1. Your direct superior is the Quartermaster.
2. Before any and all trips to the Automated Trade Station (ATS), Cargo Technicians must fill out the Cargo Shuttle Departure form, with their name and the current time.
3. Cargo Technicians should deliver all crates to departments within 15 minutes of the order being placed. If a crate containing security or other contraband needs delivery, a member of Security must act as an escort when possible.
4. Crates containing orders from other departments or crewmembers should never be opened by Cargo Technician, unless given express permission by the Quartermaster.
5. All order deliveries must have their blue order slips signed by the recipient, then returned to the Quartermaster for filing.
6. Station equipment, machinery, and other contents should not be sold unless mandated by Central Command’s Bounty Service.
